name: 伊格纳兹·塞梅尔维斯
bio_short: 匈牙利产科医生，被誉为“母亲的救星”和“院感控制之父”。他发现了产褥热的成因，并强制推行“洗手”（`semmelweis_handwashing_1847`），极大地降低了产妇死亡率，尽管在当时遭到了医学界的排挤。
bio_short_en: A Hungarian obstetrician, known as the 'Savior of Mothers' and the 'Father of Infection Control'. He discovered the cause of puerperal fever and mandated 'handwashing' (`semmelweis_handwashing_1847`), drastically reducing mortality rates, although he was ostracized by the medical community at the time.
